blocks.text: Pituitary gland hypothalamus se aik danthal, infundibulum, ke zariye latakta hai aur is ke teen lobes hain: anterior, posterior aur intermediate (median).

blocks.caption: Pituitary ke hormones
rows: muscles, haddiyon (bilwasta) aur doosre tissues ki nashonuma; theek metabolism ke liye zaroori
adrenal cortex se corticosteroids chhurwata jo glucose aur namak ka tawazun rakhte
thyroid se thyroxine banwata jo oxidative respiration barhata
auraton mein: ovaries progesterone aur estrogen banati, ovulation; mardon mein: testes testosterone banate
auraton mein: ovarian follicles ki nashonuma; mardon mein: sperm ki nashonuma (FSH aur LH gonadotropins hain)
mammary glands doodh banate; dono jinson mein banta, kaam sirf auraton mein
doodh ka bahar aana (mammary glands ke smooth muscle ka sukarna); paidaish mein rahim ka sukarna
jild aur baalon ke melanocytes melanin banate aur chhorte

blocks.text: Posterior pituitary hormones nahi banata: is mein hypothalamus ke axons hain aur yeh wahan bane hormones sirf jama kar ke chhorta hai. Yeh janeen (embryo) mein asabi tissue ke ubhar se banta hai, isi liye hypothalamus se axons ki aik raah se juda rehta hai. Doodh pilane wali maaon mein paidaish ke baad bhi oxytocin nikalta rehta hai, is liye rahim jald apne naarmal size par aata hai.

blocks.alt: Hypothalamus, us ka danthal aur pituitary ke do lobes; anterior lobe tak khoon ki nalyan aur posterior lobe tak hypothalamus ke axons. Anterior pituitary se hare teer: TSH thyroid ko, ACTH adrenal cortex ko, FSH aur LH ovary aur testis ko, GH haddiyon aur skeletal muscles ko, prolactin mammary glands (chhati ke ghadood) ko. Posterior pituitary se laal teer: oxytocin mammary glands aur uterus (rahim) ko, ADH gurde ko.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.3: Anterior aur posterior pituitary ke hormones aur un ke target (kitab ki Figure 16.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; anterior ke tamam teer anterior lobe se).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hare teer anterior pituitary ke hormones hain aur laal teer posterior pituitary ke. Kitab ki tasveer mein GH aur prolactin ke teer posterior lobe ke neeche se nikalte dikhte hain, halanke yeh dono anterior pituitary ke hormones hain (kitab ka apna matn bhi yahi kehta hai). Is liye hamare khaake mein anterior ke tamam hormones (TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH, GH, prolactin) anterior lobe se nikalte hain. Posterior lobe sirf do hormones chhorta hai: oxytocin (rahim aur chhati ke ghadood) aur ADH (gurda), jo asal mein hypothalamus mein bante hain.

items: Barhte bachche mein zyada GH: gigantism, ausat se bohat zyada qad aur bare haath, paon aur chehra. Balighon mein zyada GH: acromegaly, haddiyan moti hoti magar lambi nahi ho saktin, to haath, paon, khopri, naak aur jabra bare ho jate hain.
Kam GH: dwarfism (baunapan), aahista nashonuma aur chhota qad, magar jism ke hisse mutanasib rehte aur dimagh ki nashonuma aur IQ mutasir nahi hote.
Zyada TSH: hyperthyroidism (zyada thyroxine); kam: hypothyroidism (thyroxine ki kami).
Kam ADH: diabetes insipidus, bohat sa patla peshab aur baar baar pyaas; zyada ADH gurde ke masail la sakta hai.
Zyada oxytocin rahim ki deewar phaar sakta hai; kam naarmal zachgi mein rukawat dalta hai.

blocks.title: Growth hormone ka ilaj
blocks.text: GH un bachon ko diya jata hai jo GH ki kami ki wajah se chhote hain, aur yeh un ki nashonuma ki raftar barhata hai. Har chhote qad wale mein GH ki kami nahi hoti, is liye yeh ilaj har kisi ke liye nahi, aur doctor muscle banane ya budhapa rokne ke liye GH ke istemal ki himayat nahi karte.

blocks.prompt: Pituitary ko master gland kyun kehte hain, aur yeh poori kahani kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Is ka anterior lobe aise hormones (ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH) chhorta hai jo doosre endocrine glands ko qaboo karte hain. Magar yeh khud hypothalamus ke qaboo mein hai, jo releasing aur inhibiting hormones bhejta aur posterior pituitary ke hormones banata hai.

items: Anterior: GH, ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH, prolactin. Posterior (jama karta): ADH, oxytocin. Intermediate: MSH.
Adam tawazun: gigantism, acromegaly, dwarfism, thyroid ke masail, diabetes insipidus, zachgi ke masail.
